description: This file contains functions and classes related to exporting session data as an HTML file, including loading templates, generating HTML content, parsing export commands, and handling the export process within a session management context.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Reads an HTML template file from the export-html directory.

methods.name: generateHtml
methods.description: Generates an HTML page string from session data, embedding session info and styling.

methods.name: parseExportArgs
methods.description: Parses command input to extract optional output path for session export.

methods.name: buildExportSessionReply
methods.description: Main function to handle session export command, resolves session file, loads data, generates HTML, and saves to disk.
